def solution(n):
    ways = [0] * (n + 1)
    ways[2] = 1
    ways[3] = 1
    for i in range(4, n + 1):
        ways[i] = ways[i - 2] + ways[i - 3]
    return ways[n]

def solution(clicks):
    n = len(clicks)
    best = [0] * n
    best[0] = clicks[0]
    best[1] = max(clicks[0], clicks[1])
    for i in range(2, n):
        best[i] = max(best[i - 1], best[i - 2] + clicks[i])
    return best[n - 1]
